_readme: Verified cases for the 'case' scene. Every entry has a source that was checked on the 'as_of' date. Translate headline/labels into the film language; keep numbers exactly. 'stage' maps to the challenger sequence in SKILL.md (1 margin-around-the-core, 2 buyer agents, 3 talent, 4 roll-up/contract capacity, 5 AI-native capacity from scratch, 0 market signal). Add new cases only with a fetched source. 'leads' are names worth checking — never use them in a film before verifying. 'geo' (lat, lon, precision) is for the 'map' scene: precision 'city' is a verified place, 'country' is a point inside the country (label it with the country, never with a city). Hadrian and Xometry share one point in the USA: show them as one dot. Attacker types and the reasoning that uses these cases: data/threat-playbook.md.
